subject.title: Automatic git worktree management for agent tasks

question: Should OpenClaw adopt managed git worktrees as a core service through the linked implementation PR, or narrow/defer this into a smaller plugin/API design?
rationale: The request aligns with agent-harness and CLI/web ergonomics goals, but it creates new core lifecycle, protocol, state, UI, SDK, and security-sensitive hook surfaces that automation should not accept without maintainer intent.

options.title: Review the linked core PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100535 as the canonical implementation candidate and decide it through normal maintainer review after its blockers are addressed.

options.title: Narrow the scope first
options.body: Keep this issue open but ask for a staged design or smaller PR sequence that separates core service, Workboard materialization, UI, and SDK exposure.

options.title: Defer core ownership
options.body: Pause or reject the linked PR if maintainers decide managed worktrees should live outside core or behind a different extension API first.

recommendation.title: Review the linked core PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100535 as the canonical implementation candidate and decide it through normal maintainer review after its blockers are addressed.
